title: Componentwise transport of composite natural isomorphisms
statement: For functors F0,F1,F2,F3:C→D, natural isomorphisms a:F0≅F1 and b:F2≅F3 and equality h:F1=F2, define a natural isomorphism F0≅F3 whose K-component is a(K) followed by equality transport of F1(K)=F2(K), followed by b(K).

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Use NatIso.ofComponents with the stated component isomorphisms. Substituting h reduces naturality to naturality of a and b and the category identity laws.
